eq6_endpoint_x1.note: the numerator at x = 1 equals the denominator term by term; round-off only

eq6_vs_integrated_worst.note: two closed forms of one function; round-off only

eq6_to_film_limit.note: the gap is proportional to gamma, with coefficient below 1

eq6_to_ash_limit.note: the gap is proportional to 1/omega, with coefficient below 0.3

eq6_to_reaction_limit.note: the gap is proportional to omega, with coefficient below 0.5

limit_gap_scaling_dev.note: log10 of the gap ratio against log10 of the parameter ratio, 1e-5 against 1e-9

shell_order_finest_min.note: second-order scheme, approached from below on the thick shell (pre-asymptotic rungs)

shell_conservation_gap.note: flow to the core against flow delivered by the film; round-off of the sparse solve, which grows with the grid

shell_interior_face_gap.note: the flow through the first interior face equals the core-face flow; round-off only

shell_finest_over_roundoff.note: finest difference of the ladder over the conservation gap, which is the round-off of the same solve

map_fraction_change_finest.note: last doubling of the grid changes the fractions by less than a tenth of a percentage point

map_cells_within_5pct.note: no cell lies within a relative 1e-8 of the 5 % threshold, so the count is not decided by round-off

map_cells_within_2pct.note: no cell lies within a relative 1e-8 of the 2 % threshold, so the count is not decided by round-off

crest_reaction_share_omega1e3.note: reaction resistance over the sum of the three at the crest, at the edge of the map; it falls as 1/omega

eq6_endpoint_x1: cubic coefficient read as omega (1 - gamma) (eq6(..., cubic='misread'))
eq6_vs_integrated_worst: film term without the factor 3 (groups(..., film_factor=1))
k_d1 = 6 D/D_p instead of 12 D/D_p (groups(..., kd_coef=6))
eq6_to_film_limit: limit parameters 1e-5 instead of 1e-9 (ash: omega = 1e5 instead of 1e7)
eq6_to_ash_limit: limit parameters 1e-5 instead of 1e-9 (ash: omega = 1e5 instead of 1e7)
eq6_to_reaction_limit: limit parameters 1e-5 instead of 1e-9 (ash: omega = 1e5 instead of 1e7)
limit_gap_scaling_dev: ladder 1e-1 and 1e-5: outside the linear range
shell_solve_worst_rel_err: spherical geometry replaced by cylindrical (Shell(..., nu=1))
reaction condition written with the inward normal (Shell(..., inner_normal='inward'))
film resistance dropped, bulk value at the surface (Shell(..., film=False))
flow read from the first two cells at the core radius (read='cells_at_core')
shell_order_finest_min: flow read from the first two cells at the core radius (read='cells_at_core')
shell_order_finest_max: flow read from the first two cells at the core radius (read='cells_at_core')
shell_conservation_gap: film flow from the last cell value instead of the surface value (flow_outer(read='cell'))
shell_interior_face_gap: flow read from the first two cells at the core radius (read='cells_at_core')
shell_finest_over_roundoff: ladder 200 to 3200 cells, where the differences approach round-off
frac_within_5pct: ash law with (1-X) in place of 2(1-X), on the 90 x 90 grid (regime_map(..., laws=...))
cubic coefficient read as omega (1 - gamma), on the 90 x 90 grid (regime_map(..., cubic='misread'))
frac_within_2pct: ash law with (1-X) in place of 2(1-X), on the 90 x 90 grid (regime_map(..., laws=...))
cubic coefficient read as omega (1 - gamma), on the 90 x 90 grid (regime_map(..., cubic='misread'))
worst_single_law_error: cubic coefficient read as omega (1 - gamma), on the 90 x 90 grid (regime_map(..., cubic='misread'))
map_fraction_change_finest: ladder stopped at 90 and 180 per decade pair
map_cells_within_5pct: 5 % threshold applied as 5e-3 (a factor ten off)
map_cells_within_2pct: 2 % threshold applied as 2e-3 (a factor ten off)
crest_error_omega1e3: gamma scan of 90 points in place of the bounded maximum (crest(..., method='grid', n_scan=90))
reaction law with exponent 1/2 in place of 1/3 (crest(..., laws=...))
crest_error_omega1e6: gamma scan of 90 points in place of the bounded maximum (crest(..., method='grid', n_scan=90))
reaction law with exponent 1/2 in place of 1/3 (crest(..., laws=...))
crest_gamma_omega1e6: gamma scan of 90 points in place of the bounded maximum (crest(..., method='grid', n_scan=90))
reaction law with exponent 1/2 in place of 1/3 (crest(..., laws=...))
